changelog:
**Build for Jellyfin 12.**

- fix(status-tags): only show New Episode on recent air date, not on recent add
 - test(status-tags): update New Episode badge test for air-date-only rule
 - fix(tags): redraw changed cards and keep collection language flags current ([#1029](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1029))
 - fix(toast): let a duration of 0 turn toasts off and make the preview match
 - test(parity): update New Episode status fixture for the air-date-only rule
 - chore(ci)(deps): bump the github-actions group with 6 updates ([#1031](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1031))
 - feat(watchlist): two-way removal sync between Jellyfin and Seerr ([#1032](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1032))
 - ci: skip browser tests on pull requests that do not touch web files
 - fix(spoiler-guard): strip Home Screen Sections rows ([#1033](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1033))
 - fix(recommendations): don't open category tiles after dragging a row ([#1030](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1030))
 - fix(audio-language): show audio languages on movie page
 - ci: Fix/code scanning alerts ([#1036](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1036))
 - ci(regression): run the browser suite as one parallel job per Playwright project
 - docs(readme): add test badges and icons, recolor badge row
 - feat(leaving-soon): show the Maintainerr key like the TMDB key, add a Maintainerr card and wider URL fields
 - feat(status-tags): add an admin switch for status badges on collections
 - fix(status-tags): base a collection's Just Added on its newest member
 - fix(config): search and New badges for the Media Tags tab, tidy the Maintainerr card link
 - fix(tags): keep a flush status tag at the top edge, over the count and watched badges
 - fix(spoiler-guard): keep a neutral Path on guarded items so Download works
 - feat(rating-tags): add MyAnimeList, AniList, Metacritic user, Roger Ebert and MDBList sources
 - feat(status-tags): show Binge ready instead of Series Finale on a show released in one drop
 - test(status-tags): count Binge Ready among the status styles
 - feat(status-tags): hide New Episode on a series or season the viewer has watched in full
 - fix(activity): use a real Material icon for User created
 - fix(leaving-soon): page through every Maintainerr collection member
 - fix(activity): show plays and favorites of versions, people and genres ([#1042](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1042))
 - fix(tests): make generator scripts and coverage test work on Windows
 - fix(leaving-soon): fall back to the embedded members when the paged endpoint answers something else, update request counts
 - feat(player): open the native playback info overlay from the shortcut, keep plugin overlay as fallback
 - fix(mdblist): keep rating scores a batch answer leaves out ([#1047](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1047))
 - feat(seerr): the discovery sections join the page, with Jellyfin's controls, a Filters menu and role lines ([#1044](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1044))
 - Translations update from Hosted Weblate ([#1049](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1049))
 - perf(tags): stop every tag-cache delta re-sending a rebuild's entries ([#1053](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1053))
 - fix(arr): keep synced tags when Radarr or Sonarr can't be read, and make a blank Tag Prefix mean the default ([#1054](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1054))
 - fix(seerr): Seerr routes follow the caller's library access and Jellyfin's parental rules ([#1055](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1055))
 - fix(hidden-content): saves keep changes made elsewhere and never replace a list that failed to load ([#1056](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1056))
 - Translations update from Hosted Weblate ([#1057](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1057))
 - feat(elsewhere): streaming providers from Seerr when there is no TMDB key ([#1058](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1058))
 - feat(poster-tags): draw native poster tags on Thumb images
 - feat(maintainerr): mark, keep and postpone removals from the item menu, and a Leaving soon home row
 - chore(docs): version the docs with mike (dev for main, latest for releases)
 - Translated using Weblate (Korean)
 - chore(docs): allow back filling released docs versions from older tags
 - chore(docs): title the docs versions main and latest in the version picker
 - fix(leaving-soon): skip the scheduled refresh when nothing uses the data and log it to the enhanced log
 - chore(tests): regenerate production inventory
 - fix(recommendations): keep tab content, fix Back handling on mobile, drop row masks on touch
 - feat(tags): hide individual tags from the Colours tag list
 - feat(tags): set the text of quality, genre, status and awards tags from the Colours and text tab ([#1063](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1063))
 - chore(tags): regenerate the inventory and config flag groups for tag text
 - fix(tags): keep incomplete custom rules when the editor auto-saves
 - feat(seerr): remove watched requests automatically and add a Remove request button ([#1050](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1050))
 - feat(player): sync subtitles to the line you just heard ([#1068](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1068))
 - Translations update from Hosted Weblate ([#1067](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1067))
 - fix(player): run player shortcuts in Jellyfin Desktop's mpv player ([#1069](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1069))
 - Translations update from Hosted Weblate ([#1070](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1070))
description: A combination of the Jellyfin Enhanced and Jellyfin Elsewhere userscripts, providing a comprehensive set of tweaks and features for Jellyfin.
name: Jellyfin Enhanced
overview: Jellyfin Enhanced and Jellyfin Elsewhere for a better Jellyfin experience.
